rulings.reason: In the executed facts turning_right falls at t=500 and rises again at t=750, so 750 is the new observed beginning. The heading change since it is 0, which reaches −0 first at 750, so the contract holds there. The body fails because its rising edge looks at the heading comparison, which was already true at t=500 when measured from the old onset; that is a wrong onset, not a choice of parameter size.
rulings.quote: The act's observed beginning is the observation at which drv.motion.turning_right last became true. The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change since that beginning first reaches the negative of the turn angle.
